title: Anne Frank Remembered DVD 2004 Biography Documentary - Good
descriptionText:
From Moorpark Library.

This DVD, titled "Anne Frank Remembered," is a must-have for anyone interested in the life of Anne Frank and the history of World War II. The DVD, released in 2004, features a biography of Anne Frank and the story of her family's experiences during the war. The DVD is in the format of a documentary and includes interviews with experts, historians, and survivors.

The DVD is rated G and is suitable for all ages. It falls under the categories of Movies & TV and DVDs & Blu-ray Discs. The director of the documentary is Jon Blair and the genre falls under Education/General Interest and Educational. This DVD is a great addition to any collection and a valuable resource for anyone interested in learning more about Anne Frank and the history of World War II.
